product.name: Squatch Gate
product.description: Noise gate (the browser rig's NoiseGate): opens when the smoothed peak reaches the threshold, closes below threshold minus hysteresis after the hold time, with one-pole attack and release to the range floor.

params.name: Threshold
params.note: Level of the peak envelope (20 ms release) at which a closed gate opens, dBFS. Range and default are the browser rig's (parity fixes 2, 2026-10-11).

params.name: Hysteresis
params.note: A positive magnitude: an open gate stays open down to threshold - hysteresis. Settled 2026-09-25; the C++ block used a negative offset before (-30..0).

params.name: Range
params.note: Gain when closed (the floor). 0 dB turns the gate into a meter.

params.name: Attack
params.note: Time constant of the gain rising to unity (it covers 63 % of the distance in this time).

params.name: Hold
params.note: How long the level must stay under the close level before the gate closes (rounded to samples; 0 closes at once).

params.name: Release
params.note: Time constant of the gain falling to the floor. It is a time constant, not the time to cross the range: 90 ms takes about 8.7 dB in the first time constant.

params.name: Bypass
params.note: CLAP polarity: 1 means bypassed. The host keeps processing and crossfades to the latency-aligned input.
